objective: Determine the coarsest column-capacity label that becomes Q-V sufficient when jointly canonicalized with REL_INC column roles before ZOE aggregation.
motivation: EW-RS-053 shows the exact unordered per-column capacity profile still leaves 2 mixed classes on 4x4-k4 and 41 on 4x5-k4.
Those failures preserve REL_INC and the unordered exact capacity multiset, so only the association between a capacity state and an incidence column role remains structurally unresolved at this seam.
Foundational IA round 50 requires a minimal role-aligned capacity ladder before any unrelated component feature is added.

frozenCountState.name: ZOE
frozenCountState.definition: After structural identity aggregation, omit zero multiplicity, emit O for positive odd total multiplicity, and E for positive even total multiplicity.

candidates.name: ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE
candidates.definition: Jointly canonicalize REL_INC with one capacity-parity bit (H-h_c mod 2) attached to each local incidence column role; aggregate equal descriptors; apply ZOE.

candidates.name: ROLE_CAP3_REL_INC_ZOE
candidates.definition: Jointly canonicalize REL_INC with per-column capacity state Z when H-h_c=0, O when positive odd, and E when positive even; aggregate equal descriptors; apply ZOE.

candidates.name: ROLE_CAP_EXACT_REL_INC_ZOE
candidates.definition: Jointly canonicalize REL_INC with exact per-column remaining capacity H-h_c attached to each local incidence column role; aggregate equal descriptors; apply ZOE.

antiCircularity: All three role-aligned capacity grades are frozen before qualification.
Capacity labels depend only on board height and current local column frontier heights.
Joint canonicalization is performed over local column permutations before any solved outcome is consulted.
No W/D/L label selects a column, capacity state, component, merge, phase grade, or coefficient.
falsifiers: Any mixed EXACT_ZOE class invalidates the established control.
Any mixed class rejects that role-aligned capacity grade on that carrier.

ROLE_CAP_EXACT_REL_INC_ZOE must retain scalar purity; failure would indicate a descriptor/harness defect because exact aligned capacity plus REL_INC reconstructs the exact component geometry up to the same local column isomorphism.
selectionRule: If multiple grades are Q-V exact across all derivation carriers, retain the coarsest grade in the declared order ROLE_CAPPAR < ROLE_CAP3 < ROLE_CAP_EXACT.
nextIfCoarseSuccess: Freeze the coarsest common passing role-aligned descriptor and qualify it unchanged on fresh non-affine 5x4-k4.
nextIfOnlyExactSuccess: Freeze exact aligned capacity as a reconstruction boundary, then inspect the collision family separating ROLE_CAP3 from exact capacity before any further feature is added.
nextIfExactFails: Treat as a mechanical descriptor error; do not interpret as a semantic falsifier.
interpretationGuards: Passing establishes bounded Q-V sufficiency only, not Q-A/Q-F.
Exact role-aligned capacity is a control, not presumed compression.
No standard-7x6 or universal theorem follows.
